page.layout: One printed page: title and subtitle at top, then a single column of index entries with page numbers at right; a signature-like mark "L. Beccanus" at the foot. No margin notes of text except partial cropped fragments at the left edge, not transcribed.

main_text.l: Eorum qui laudantur, illustrantur, emendantur ac defenduntur.

page.notes: Printed page numbers in the index are partly underlined or highlighted in blue; the heading "A." and the entry names in italics follow the print. Several entry names are in italic type with a blackletter-style initial "A" and "C" ornaments, read as the initial letter of each name. Some entries are doubtful: the first "Abdias" reads "Bdias" in print and "Alciatus" may be "Alciatus" with a swash A; the Greek-style "Athenaeus" reading is uncertain. The left-edge fragments and stains are not transcribed.
